name: UNO-Bench
intro: UNO-Bench 是 LongCat-Flash-Omni 报告提出的跨模态推理 benchmark，包含人工编写问题并覆盖多种任务类型。
build_method: 人工整理全模态与增强单模态样本, 跨模态可解性核验, 六题型通用评分器
metric: Rule-based Accuracy and Validated General-Scorer Score
modality: 文本, 图像, 音频
build_method_en: Human-curated omni-modal and enhanced uni-modal samples, cross-modality solvability checks, six-format general scorer
intro_en: UNO-Bench is a cross-modal reasoning benchmark introduced by LongCat-Flash-Omni, with human-crafted questions spanning many task types.
scale_en: 3,730 samples, 44 task types, and 5 modality combinations
metric_en: Rule-based Accuracy and Validated General-Scorer Score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with UNO-Bench arXiv:2510.18915; official meituan-longcat/UNO-Bench repository. UNO-Bench jointly measures uni-modal and omni-modal intelligence across 44 task types and five modality combinations. The authors human-curate 1,250 omni-modal samples and verify that 98 percent are solvable across modalities, then add 2,480 enhanced uni-modal samples for a 3,730-sample suite. It includes multiple-choice and multi-step open-ended questions. A compressed evaluation set accelerates public-benchmark evaluation while preserving reported consistency. A general scoring model supports six question formats and is human-validated at 95-percent scoring accuracy. Results compare uni-modal and omni-modal scores to analyze the paper's compositional law and bottleneck effect.
